'''Wintag''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. She worked as an [[Historian/Legends|archivist]] for the Republic, exploring the ruins of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]].

==Biography==
A human female, Wintag began working for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as an archivist during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Stationed on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], Wintag was working on the Republic Tarisian Archival Database, but she was allergic to something in the air. While based at [[Border assault post|Waypoint Station Morne]], her sickness prevented her from exploring actively herself. She hired a Republic-allied individual to investigate for her. She was searching for the Tarisian government's archive, which was lost in the bombardment, but she finally managed to locate it. The area was overrun with rakghouls, however, and the hero was forced to battle their way through to the archive. The individual discovered that the archive was in fact the members of the government themselves, frozen in carbonite. The individual would inform Wintag's assistant [[Tiffan Nye]] in [[Olaris]] of the discovery, who began gathering a team to access the archive.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Wintag was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. She appears in Waypoint Station Morne on the Republic version of Taris, where she gives Republic players the mission "The Archive".<ref name="TOR" />
